statements.text: I am pleased to hear that companies are looking to Northeastern Pennsylvania for their data centers, which can serve as catalysts for economic growth and technological innovation for our region as we work towards fostering a 22nd century workforce. The second fastest growing industry in Northeastern Pennsylvania is energized land, which will help power these data centers.
statements.venue: Statement to the Times Leader, quoted by WVIA

statements.text: [We need] to empower our state representatives, our state legislators and our commonwealth to be able to make decisions without having to go through the bureaucratic process.
statements.venue: WVIA News, remarks at Pennsylvania Energy & Economic Opportunity meeting on data centers and AI

statements.text: We had a great discussion at Lackawanna College on Pennsylvania’s energy future, highlighting natural gas, AI, and data centers. This is an issue that unites both political sides and brings together labor unions and private industry to build a skilled workforce. https://t.co/O4w4DiWAdM

We’re looking at an additional 11 gigawatts of demand in my district alone. [...] Our job in Congress is to figure out how to get the shovels in the ground fast enough while protecting residents on fixed incomes.
statements.venue: Forbes article (remarks at AI4 conference), hosted on Bresnahan's House website

statements.text: AI isn’t going anywhere. Data centers aren’t going anywhere. But if we do this right, we can grow without pricing people out of their homes.
statements.venue: Forbes article on AI power demand, hosted on Bresnahan's House website

statements.text: I met with @ParisHilton during our @ProbSolveCaucus  meeting yesterday to talk about the DEFIANCE Act, giving victims of non-consensual AI deepfakes stronger protections and legal options. Her fight against AI deepfakes is important, and I cosponsored this bill to make these protections a reality.

We should never let billion-dollar corporations supersede the voices of those who live in the community. [...] The people who live here, work here, and raise their families here are the ones who know what's best for our communities.
statements.venue: Statement on Local Control Protection Act (data centers), via Axios

statements.text: Under no circumstances should Washington, D.C., be telling anyone what they’re forced to live next to or coexist with.
statements.venue: 8th District congressional debate, on data centers
